title: Comprehensive Biophysical Profiling Evidences Self-Oligomerization of Bacterially Expressed Pc Protein.
authors: Zahid, Maria; Prajapati, Sabin; Alamdari, Ghazaleh; Tittmann, Kai; Kara, Selin
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文对果蝇Pc蛋白进行生物物理表征，研究其自寡聚化与内在无序性，虽涉及染色质调控但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且方法以实验为主、AI建模仅辅助，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Polycomb (Pc) protein is a core component of Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 (PRC1) and plays a central role in epigenetic gene silencing, particularly during embryo development. Despite extensive functional characterization, structural understanding of Pc remains limited due to its intrinsic disorder, low sequence complexity, and propensity for dynamic self-association. Here, we report the recombinant production, purification, and biophysical characterization of Drosophila melanogaster Pc constructs optimized for structural studies. Using solubility-enhancing fusion strategies, we obtained milligram quantities of stable MBP-tagged Pc protein suitable for downstream analyses. Sequence-based disorder prediction, circular dichroism, and solution-based techniques indicate that Pc is predominantly intrinsically disordered outside its conserved chromodomain, whereas it retains a defined secondary structure upon fusion and oligomerization. Thermal shift assays, Nano-Differential Scanning Fluorimetry (nanoDSF), dynamic light scattering (DLS), and Size exclusion chromatography coupled to multi-angle light scattering (SEC-MALS) demonstrate strong buffer-dependent stability and concentration-dependent self-association into higher-order assemblies. Cryo-electron microscopy reveals pronounced conformational and oligomeric heterogeneity, which can be partially stabilized by gradient fixation. Complementary AlphaFold-based modeling supports a conditional folding mechanism in which Pc adopts more ordered architectures upon self-association. Together, our results establish a robust framework for the biophysical investigation of Pc protein and provide mechanistic insight into how intrinsic disorder, oligomerization, and self-association may contribute to Polycomb-mediated chromatin regulation.
abstract_zh: Polycomb (Pc) 蛋白是Polycomb抑制复合物1 (PRC1) 的核心组分，在表观遗传基因沉默中发挥核心作用，尤其在胚胎发育过程中。尽管已有广泛的功能表征，但由于其内在无序性、低序列复杂度以及动态自缔合倾向，Pc 的结构理解仍然有限。在此，我们报告了为结构研究优化的黑腹果蝇 (Drosophila melanogaster) Pc 构建体的重组生产、纯化及生物物理表征。利用增溶融合策略，我们获得了毫克级稳定的 MBP 标记 Pc 蛋白，适用于下游分析。基于序列的无序性预测、圆二色光谱及溶液技术表明，Pc 在其保守的染色质域 (chromodomain) 之外主要为内在无序，而在融合及寡聚化时保留明确的二级结构。热位移分析、纳米差示扫描荧光法 (nanoDSF)、动态光散射 (DLS) 及尺寸排阻色谱联用多角度光散射 (SEC-MALS) 显示，Pc 具有强烈的缓冲液依赖性稳定性及浓度依赖性自缔合，形成高阶组装体。冷冻电子显微镜揭示出显著的构象和寡聚异质性，可通过梯度固定部分稳定。互补的 AlphaFold 建模支持一种条件性折叠机制，即 Pc 在自缔合时采用更有序的结构。综合来看，我们的结果为 Pc 蛋白的生物物理研究建立了稳健框架，并提供了关于内在无序性、寡聚化及自缔合如何可能促进 Polycomb 介导的染色质调控的机制性见解。
